content: Ambient wildlife in games is overwhelmingly implemented as near-zero-AI particles/billboards gated by time-of-day: butterflies flap and flit via wander noise during daylight, fireflies float lazily and glow on/off at night (Steam Workshop, RPG Maker, Stardew and Minecraft mods all converge on this). Standard behavior contract: passive, avoids/flees the player, no pathfinding, no persistence. Startle/flush reaction to player approach is the single highest-value behavior beyond wandering. Audio integration (bird calls from tree positions filling gaps) makes soundscape feel fuller (Garden Life deep dive). Sources: steamcommunity workshop 1710344555, bitqueststudio.itch.io, giantbomb ambient-wildlife concept, gamedeveloper.com Garden Life.
